draft.inside_message: Happy birthday from all of us in Manchester. You got Northgate over the line in June and you still had the energy to drag half the office round a 5k on Thursdays. Take the day at your own pace for once.

artwork_brief.style_note: loose confetti, lots of white space, brand colours

draft.rationale: Leans on the Northgate close and the Thursday 5k club for specificity, with the light, clipped warmth of Sarah's own voice and no reference to age.
